collection.name: Chapter 12
collection.notes: I would like to buy gifts for my parents
collection.objectives: Talk about what gifts to buy for family; list the advantages of shopping online; compare shopping online versus in-person

words.english: to return, (to go back, to come back)

words.notes: Grammar: links two state verbs, e.g. 又便宜又好吃

words.english: to have time, to be free
to go out, to leave the house

words.pinyin: xià ge xīngqī / xià ge xīngqí

words.notes: Supplementary Vocabulary; Part of speech: N
Supplementary Vocabulary; Part of speech: N
Supplementary Vocabulary; Part of speech: QPr

words.pinyin: shàng ge xīngqī / shàng ge xīngqí

sentences.traditional: 大哥，我下個星期回臺灣。
sentences.simplified: 大哥，我下个星期回台湾。
sentences.pinyin: Dàgē, wǒ xià ge xīngqī huí Táiwān.
sentences.english: Big brother, I am going back to Taiwan next week.

sentences.traditional: 我想給爸爸買一個帽子，給媽媽買一件衣服。
sentences.simplified: 我想给爸爸买一个帽子，给妈妈买一件衣服。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gěi bàba mǎi yí ge màozi, gěi māma mǎi yí jiàn yīfú.
sentences.english: I want to buy a hat for Dad and an item of clothing for Mom.

sentences.traditional: 我還想給家人買兩盒巧克力。
sentences.simplified: 我还想给家人买两盒巧克力。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hái xiǎng gěi jiārén mǎi liǎng hé qiǎokèlì.
sentences.english: I also want to buy two boxes of chocolates for my family.

sentences.traditional: 在網路商店買東西比較方便。
sentences.simplified: 在网路商店买东西比较方便。
sentences.pinyin: Zài wǎnglù shāngdiàn mǎi dōngxi bǐjiào fāngbiàn.
sentences.english: Buying things at online stores is more convenient.

sentences.traditional: 網路商店的東西又好又便宜。
sentences.simplified: 网路商店的东西又好又便宜。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn de dōngxi yòu hǎo yòu piányí.
sentences.english: The goods from online stores are both good and inexpensive.

sentences.traditional: 因為我喜歡逛街，所以想去百貨公司買東西。
sentences.simplified: 因为我喜欢逛街，所以想去百货公司买东西。
sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ xǐhuān guàngjiē, suǒyǐ xiǎng qù bǎihuògōngsī mǎi dōngxi.
sentences.english: Because I like shopping in person, I want to go to a department store to buy things.

sentences.traditional: 她喜歡旅行，背包很有用。
sentences.simplified: 她喜欢旅行，背包很有用。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xǐhuān lǚxíng, bēibāo hěn yǒuyòng.
sentences.english: She likes to travel, so a backpack is very useful.

sentences.traditional: 你還可以給姊姊買太陽眼鏡。
sentences.simplified: 你还可以给姊姊买太阳眼镜。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ hái kěyǐ gěi jiějie mǎi tàiyáng yǎnjìng.
sentences.english: You can also buy sunglasses for your older sister.

sentences.traditional: 這個週末我有空，我們什麼時候出門？
sentences.simplified: 这个周末我有空，我们什么时候出门？
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò wǒ yǒukòng, wǒmen shénme shíhòu chūmén?
sentences.english: I am free this weekend; when shall we leave the house?

sentences.traditional: 王小姐為什麼常常上網買東西？
sentences.simplified: 王小姐为什么常常上网买东西？
sentences.pinyin: Wáng xiǎojiě wèishénme chángcháng shàngwǎng mǎi dōngxi?
sentences.english: Why does Miss Wang often buy things online?

sentences.traditional: 我去年去臺灣旅行，明年也想去。
sentences.simplified: 我去年去台湾旅行，明年也想去。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ qùnián qù Táiwān lǚxíng, míngnián yě xiǎng qù.
sentences.english: I traveled to Taiwan last year, and I want to go next year too.

sentences.traditional: 上個星期我給家人買了很多東西。
sentences.simplified: 上个星期我给家人买了很多东西。
sentences.pinyin: Shàng ge xīngqī wǒ gěi jiārén mǎi le hěn duō dōngxi.
sentences.english: Last week I bought a lot of things for my family.
